alt_text: 1:1 MENTORSHIP — Learn animation from a film animator.

captions.linkedin:
Most animation courses teach you software. Almost none teach you how a shot actually gets approved in a studio.

I've spent 14+ years animating creatures and characters on films like Love and Monsters, Finch, Kingsglaive and Trollhunters.

In my 1:1 mentorship I don't hand you a playlist. We sit on your shot, in your file, and I show you exactly what a supervisor would flag - weight, timing, arcs, silhouette, the stuff that decides whether a shot ships or comes back.

First demo session is free. Come with a shot, leave with a plan.

→ Book a free demo: https://mythicalmotions.com/mentorship
→ AnimBelt (Maya toolkit): https://mythicalmotions.com/animbelt
→ Everything else: https://mythicalmotions.com
→ Free animator Discord: https://discord.gg/suMy2Z7CHa
